mapper.select: SELECT access_token AS accessToken, expired_at AS expiredAt FROM api_token ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: WITH latest AS ( SELECT id FROM api_token ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ), updated AS ( UPDATE api_token SET access_token = #{accessToken}, expired_at = #{expiredAt} WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM latest) RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO api_token (access_token, expired_at) SELECT #{accessToken}, #{expiredAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
